title: Failed-Sale Charges on Real Estate Service Contract Listing Orders
content:
**Principle.** When a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order ends without a closing, the seller pays for the listing-period service Bridgewell provided.

**Which orders.** A failed-sale charge is billed only on an order in status listing expired or cancelled that never recorded a closing. Both facts are read from the system record of the order concerned — its status and whether a closing date was ever recorded — before the charge is billed. A buyer-only order never carries a failed-sale charge.

**How many.** Only one failed-sale charge is billed per order. Whether one has already been billed is read from the order's own billing records.

**Amount (retired clause) — no longer in force:** the clause under which the charge is the lesser of the plan premium invoiced on the order and the seller-phase benefit Bridgewell paid, no charge is billed when that benefit is zero, and seller service call fees already collected never reduce it. This clause is superseded by the current basis: the failed-sale charge billed on an order is the amount the current failed-sale charge basis works out in place of the plain lesser-of amount, no failed-sale charge is billed when the seller-phase benefit paid is zero, and seller service call fees already collected never reduce it.

**Billing and due date (retired clause) — no longer in force for a spread charge:** the clause under which the charge is billed to the seller and due the plan's failed-sale charge payment period, in calendar days, after billing. This clause is superseded by the current basis for a failed-sale charge the seller asks to spread, and only for such a charge: the settlement plan worked out for it replaces the single due date, the first settlement payment being taken when the plan is set up and the rest of the charge falling due in equal monthly installments, the first of them on the charge's due date. Every other failed-sale charge remains billed to the seller and due the plan's failed-sale charge payment period, in calendar days, after billing.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical orders)

| Order | Status | Closing ever recorded | Failed-sale charge already billed | Under this rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Listing order | listing expired | no | no | a charge may be billed |
| Listing order | cancelled | no | no | a charge may be billed |
| Listing order | cancelled | no | yes | no second charge |
| Listing order | closed pending payment or active | yes | — | no charge |
| Buyer-only order | cancelled | no | — | never a charge |

superseded_clauses: The charge is the lesser of the plan premium invoiced on the order (realty_msr_plan_premium_invoiced) and the seller-phase benefit Bridgewell paid (realty_msr_seller_phase_benefit_paid); no charge is billed when that benefit is zero, and seller service call fees already collected never reduce it.
The charge is billed to the seller and due failed_sale_bill_due_days calendar days after billing.
